ADDED i1: Verifies two behaviours:
  1. The default (unlimited) instance reports a distance of 0 between a sequence and itself.
  2. A threshold-limited instance
ADDED i2: The default instance has no threshold, so it computes the exact distance.
ADDED i3: A 5-character sequence compared against itself: no edits are needed.
ADDED i4: Build a distance that only accepts results within a threshold of 0.
ADDED i5: The two sequences differ in length (5 vs. 3767), which exceeds the threshold of 0, so the limited algorithm reports -1 ("over threshold").
